Here is a message you can copy and paste directly to your developer:

Bug Report: Sign-Up form triggering login endpoint (app.sangak.tr)

Hey, we ran into an issue on the account creation flow (ساخت حساب کاربری) that needs to be fixed and deployed ASAP.

The Issue:
When a user attempts to create a new account with a phone number (e.g., +90 552 200 81 18), password, and referral code (MOJTAB3ED), the form throws the toast error: "ایمیل یا رمز نادرست" (Invalid email or password).

Root Cause:

Wrong Endpoint Called: The onSubmit handler on the sign-up button is currently executing a Login / Sign-In request (signInWithPassword / /login) instead of the Registration / Sign-Up request (signUp / /register).

Auth Rejection: Because the account does not exist in the database yet, the auth service rejects the login credentials.

Mismatched Error Text: The catch block on this component is returning a hardcoded email/password login error message instead of registration-specific feedback.

Required Fix:

Update Submit Handler: Point the sign-up form’s submit trigger to the registration routine/RPC (signUp) rather than the login routine.

Verify Payload: Ensure the phone number, password, and referral code (MOJTAB3ED) are cleanly passed into the registration payload.

Update Error Handling: Swap out the generic login error toast for accurate registration responses (e.g., "Phone number already registered" or exact backend validation errors).

Please push this fix to production as soon as possible.
